info.description:
Self-hosted SQLite databases with branches. Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.

Databases, buckets and tokens live in workspaces. A request acts in the workspace of its token; an instance token, which belongs to none, acts in the default workspace. To name a workspace, put `/v1/workspaces/{workspace}` in front of a path under `/v1/databases`, `/v1/trash`, `/v1/buckets`, `/v1/tokens`, `/v1/audit` or `/v1/s3` (for example `/v1/workspaces/acme/databases`), or of `/libsql` and `/mcp`. A token that belongs to a workspace can only name its own; any other gets `workspace_not_found`.
